summary: Part 4 of 5 of the Revibe training video '11.0 Dashboard (KAMs)' (19:39 to 25:19 of a 29:58 video). It walks the KAM tab (Invalid claims, Cancellation, Sellers connections), then one seller (M4U Mobile) on the Sellers tab's KAM view (orders, on time, stuck orders, quality, claims management, cancellation, meetings, legal), then introduces the Scores tab (four KPIs, score ladder, Expected DR). All 40 frames in the pack were opened. The Seller view is never shown on screen, and the right-hand columns of the Scores table are cut off in every Scores frame. The narration on the mekko chart contradicts the on-screen definition, and M4U Mobile's on-time and expected defect-rate figures differ between screens.
